basic_details.job_title: SAI Technical Officials Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 40 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Sports Authority of India (SAI) will engage 40 Technical Officials for the conduct of Softball Sport in the Khelo India Youth Games 2026, Telangana, under Notification No. 05/2026/Softball. A valid license or pass in an officiating examination is mandatory, and candidates aged 60 or more will not be considered. The application form is available only online on the SAI website from 2 November 2026 to 12 November 2026, and applications by email or post will not be accepted.

how_to_apply: Open the application form on the SAI jobs portal (https://sportsauthorityofindia.nic.in/saijobs/), available from 2 November 2026 to 12 November 2026.
Upload the documents mentioned in the scrutiny criteria, self-attested.
Submit the online application by 12 November 2026.
Applications via email or post shall not be accepted.
Self-attested proof of a valid officiating license/pass in an officiating examination (national certificate from the competent authority, or International Federation certificate)
Self-attested proof of officiating experience at State/National level and in Khelo India Games/National Games (2021-2026)

content_sections.heading: About SAI Technical Officials
content_sections.text: The Sports Authority of India is engaging these Technical Officials for one event: the Softball competition of the Khelo India Youth Games (KIYG) 2026, to be held in Telangana. The notice is issued by the Khelo India Events wing and signed by Gunupuru Madhu Harsha, AD, Khelo India Events, Sports Authority of India. It is an engagement for the conduct of the Games.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. What it requires is officiating credentials, judged as follows: National Technical Officials: only the officiating examination/certificate issued by the competent authority till the year 2026 shall be considered. International Technical Officials: the relevant certificate issued by the International Federation. Experience: officiating experience at State/National level and in Khelo India Games/National Games earns marks; only tournaments held between 2021-2026 shall be considered. Age: a candidate of age 60 or more shall not be considered. The notice prints no cut-off date for counting age. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

rows.preference: Preference shall be given to international Technical Officials

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: SAI selects the Technical Officials by scrutiny of applications on a total of 100 marks. The notice does not mention a written test or an interview. Valid license/pass in officiating examination: 20 marks For both experience heads, only tournaments held between 2021-2026 shall be considered. A total number of 40 TOs shall be selected for the Games. The ratio of male to female Technical Officials shall be maintained at 60:40. Female TOs scoring a minimum of 50 marks are to be selected directly. A maximum of 5 TOs per State/UT are to be selected. A candidate of age 60 or more shall not be considered. In case of a tie due to the above conditions, the steering committee will finalise the shortlisted official(s).

faq.question: Q1. How many Technical Officials will SAI select for Softball at KIYG 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 40 Technical Officials will be selected for the Softball Sport of the Khelo India Youth Games 2026, Telangana.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for online application is 12 November 2026; the form opened on 2 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed?
faq.answer: A valid license or pass in an officiating examination is mandatory. National officials need a certificate from the competent authority issued till 2026, and international officials need the relevant International Federation certificate.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: A candidate of age 60 or more shall not be considered.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Apply online on the SAI jobs portal (https://sportsauthorityofindia.nic.in/saijobs/) and upload the self-attested documents. Applications via email or post are not accepted.

faq.question: Q6. How will Technical Officials be selected?
faq.answer: Applications are scrutinised on 100 marks: 20 for the officiating license, up to 40 for State/National officiating experience and up to 40 for Khelo India Games/National Games experience.

faq.question: Q7. Which tournaments count towards experience marks?
faq.answer: Only tournaments held between 2021-2026 are considered for both experience categories.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any special provision for female officials?
faq.answer: Yes. The male to female ratio is kept at 60:40, and female TOs scoring a minimum of 50 marks are to be selected directly.

faq.question: Q9. How many officials can be selected from one State or UT?
faq.answer: A maximum of 5 Technical Officials per State/UT are to be selected.

faq.question: Q10. Do international officials get preference?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice says preference shall be given to international Technical Officials.
